query: For my 91-year-old female patient: among hospitalized females 86–96, what's the minimum duration in days of high-intensity atorvastatin (40–80 mg)?
final_sql: SELECT MIN(a.dischtime - a.admittime) AS min_length_of_stay FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN emar e ON a.subject_id = e.subject_id JOIN pharmacy ph ON e.pharmacy_id = ph.pharmacy_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 91 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 86 AND 96 AND ph.drug = 'atorvastatin' AND ph.dose_val_rx BETWEEN 40 AND 80;
